global_no_go.internal_line: p_X^*L_shared^2, flat in the selected finite/SpinC sector
global_no_go.restriction_test: On {x}xS2, the internal line has c1=0 while H_{+2} has c1=-4.
global_no_go.conclusion: There is no global connection-preserving line isomorphism and no global reduction of the helicity bundle to the finite shared Z64 carrier.

local_survival.statement: On a fixed direction or contractible momentum patch, H_{+2} is trivial and the existing plus/cross DG rows are valid.
local_survival.finite_consequence: Pi_exact64 DG(0)^*P_TT=DG(0)^*P_TT and lambda=15 are unchanged.

correct_global_object.with: a bundle-valued covariant source morphism whose local plus/cross matrices patch by the helicity transition functions
correct_global_object.typing: DG_global is a section of Hom(E_internal_exact,H_{+2}), or the source domain is explicitly twisted by H_{+2}; it is not two globally defined scalar rows.
correct_global_object.topological_obligation: Because the Hom line has c1=-4 on S2, a scalar representative cannot be everywhere nonzero; patching or zeros are mandatory.

separation_of_roles.shared_Z64: finite internal mode, half-turn, SpinC determinant, and pole support
separation_of_roles.external_U1: continuous momentum-frame helicity bundle and its nonzero Chern class
separation_of_roles.consequence: The same circle can mean compatible local weight action without being a global identity of internal and external principal bundles.
